name: blender_save_scene_as_next_version

effects.file_write: Saves a native .blend file under CGI projects/runs. Existing targets allocate the next version while holding the shared directory .version_lock OS lock.
effects.host_state_write: Updates the current scene filename and reads is_saved/is_dirty after the native save completes.

save_path.description: Optional target .blend path. Empty uses the current named scene; relative paths resolve beside the current named scene. An unnamed scene requires an absolute target. Existing files are never overwritten.

preconditions: Current named scene and target must both be unprotected paths inside CGI projects/ or runs/ managed roots; this is not per-workspace path authorization.
Existing targets allocate the next available _vNNN version using the shared Maya/Blender directory OS lock. Lock failure or timeout refuses saving; there is no unlocked fallback.
Run inside Blender on its main thread. Native save uses bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile with copy=false; current scene path changes to the actual version.

SUCCESS means the native save completed and produced a verified non-empty file at the matching current saved path. This verifies the save action and file artifact, not every in-memory or callback-driven change.

In background Blender the native dirty flag depends on window-manager notifications that are not consumed by the headless adapter. Its raw value is reported and clean_state remains UNKNOWN; SUCCESS never authorizes release or discard.

Only an actual bool bpy.app.background establishes the host mode. Missing or non-bool mode information is reported as background null and clean_state UNKNOWN; a verified save action can still succeed.
Interactive Blender retains its native dirty protection. A dirty scene after a verified save returns NEEDS_ATTENTION. Release always performs its own fresh host check.

outputs.output_path: Actual resulting .blend file path when a file exists; may also be present on a failed verification or dirty post-save result. Check status and file_size_bytes.
outputs.scene: Actual current Blender scene filepath read after a FINISHED save.
outputs.is_saved: Actual bpy.data.is_saved flag read after saving.
outputs.save_completed: True only after native FINISHED, a non-empty resulting file, matching current path and actual is_saved have all been verified.
outputs.artifact_verified: True for the non-empty native file at the matching saved current path; this is not a full scene-content equivalence check.
outputs.native_dirty: Actual unmodified bpy.data.is_dirty flag read after saving.
outputs.dirty: Compatibility field containing the same raw native flag as native_dirty. Interactive true returns NEEDS_ATTENTION; background true does not negate a verified save action.
outputs.background: Actual bool bpy.app.background, or null when the mode is missing or is not a bool.
outputs.dirty_basis: native_notifier_unconsumed for confirmed background mode, background_mode_unknown for unconfirmed mode, or native for confirmed interactive mode.
outputs.clean_state: UNKNOWN in background Blender or when the actual host mode cannot be confirmed, regardless of the raw native flag. Only confirmed interactive mode reports CLEAN or DIRTY from the native flag. UNKNOWN never authorizes default release.
outputs.file_size_bytes: Actual resulting native file size after a FINISHED save.
outputs.blocked_target: Current or allocated target path refused before invoking Blender save.

errors.BLENDER_SAVE_PATH_BLOCKED: Current or allocated target is protected or outside managed roots.
errors.BLENDER_SAVE_NOT_FINISHED: Native save operator did not return FINISHED.
errors.BLENDER_SAVE_VERIFICATION_FAILED: FINISHED did not yield a non-empty file and matching saved current scene.
errors.BLENDER_SAVE_DIRTY: The file was saved but the interactive current scene remains natively dirty.
errors.BLENDER_SAVE_OPERATION_FAILED: Invalid native path, missing host context, lock failure or native save exception.

recovery: Inspect output_path and actual scene state after any failure before deciding whether to retry. Writes are not automatically replayed.
For interactive NEEDS_ATTENTION, inspect the remaining scene edits; runtime release requires its own fresh clean check.

SUCCESS with background or unconfirmed mode and clean_state UNKNOWN proves only the verified save action. Default release remains blocked. Any separate explicit discard must be deliberately authorized after inspecting saved outputs; saving does not supply that authorization.

help.summary: Save a managed native Blender file with next-version allocation and shared directory locking; report verified save completion separately from scene cleanliness.
help.scenario: Save a resident workspace snapshot, inspect the actual artifact and reported clean_state, then separately decide whether release or explicit discard is appropriate.
help.safety: Writes only CGI projects/runs targets after protected-path checks. Existing files are not overwritten. Save and release are separate operations.

effects.scene_read: Reads exact UUID-guarded meshes, binding contexts, per-face materials, UV corners and full native weight rows.
effects.scene_write: Creates clean reduced or combined outputs, preserves supplied source transforms by default, native skin binding and compatible visibility drivers. Explicit group.consume_inputs=true combines supplied derived inputs directly and removes them after successful readback. No scene open or save.
effects.host_state_write: Restores surviving selection; requires Maya main thread and enabled native undo.

entries_path.description: Optional managed JSON array of entries; mutually exclusive with nonempty entries. Avoids retransmitting large face partitions. The adapter reads the same entry schema from this file.

analysis_workdir.description: Optional managed numeric artifact directory. Analyze reads UUID-guarded source deform inputs, returns few face groups and creates no Maya construction nodes. Uses the existing numerical session; no second environment.

weight_cleanup.description: Source-first weight preparation with max_influences, threshold, neighbor_rings and neighbor_max_delta. Original skin stays untouched. Construct/regional modes require explicit options and map computed arrays onto retained source vertices before binding final outputs once. Legacy reduce mode uses temporary same-topology skins and residual transfer repair. Empty disables cleanup only in reduce/combine modes.

mode.description: Reduce entries, regional partitions, native Combine Skinning groups, or construct groups by pruning source arrays before static reduction/merge and binding each final output once.

entries.description: Analyze entries contain source, expected_uuid, explicit positive group_count; returns compact group statistics and analysis_path containing full face lists, without scene edits. Reduce entries contain source absolute transform DAG path, expected_uuid, output_name, keep_face_ratio in (0,1], preserve_skin auto/true/false. Regional entries contain source, expected_uuid, regions [{name,faces,keep_face_ratio,preserve_border,output_name}], optional quality {max_error,max_retries,retry_factor,on_exceeded,samples_per_shell}; max_error is an explicit positive scene-space distance, max_retries is 0..2 and on_exceeded is error or keep_region. Face partitions are exhaustive. Compatible sources may share output_name and are joined statically before one final skin. Multi-source BS/component-set assembly is refused. Source ranges preserve exact identity for retained vertex mappings. Sources remain. No default percentage or universal quality threshold.

groups.description: Combine uses sources, expected_uuids, output_name, consume_inputs. Construct uses output_name and entries [{source,expected_uuid,keep_face_ratio}], requires weight_cleanup and preserves originals. Optional search mode=visual performs one Reduce per group without scoring; initial_reduction defaults 90, minimal_faces 12, and exhaustive work_groups [{name,faces,reduction,reason}] may override automatic disconnected-shell grouping. Numeric research search instead requires score_band and radius, with max_evaluations default 5. Final binding writes bounded OpenMaya blocks once per output using exact source indices. No universal score, radius or visual acceptance threshold.

character.description: Optional report identity; explicit output names remain authoritative.

preconditions: Visual search uses mode=visual, initial_reduction and optional exhaustive work_groups [{name,faces,reduction,reason}]; one Reduce per work group, zero score evaluations. Continuous semantic face regions are supplied by the Agent, not inferred from face-area clustering. Numeric score_band/radius search remains an explicit calibration option. Native full-mesh copies preserve source shading; reconstructed regions restore exact source flags without automatic softening.
Execute on Maya main thread with enabled undo and explicit UUID-guarded leaf meshes.

Ordinary reduce/combine requires skin output to match its own current skin input and rejects other deformers or downstream geometry consumers. Regional mode constructs from the pre-skin/base mesh and explicitly remaps supported local blendShape data while retaining original consumers. Both require valid normalized native weights, standard relative space, joint.worldMatrix and static bindPreMatrix; unsupported chains are refused.
Combine requires matching local visibility/display drivers, common parent, UV set names and compatible skin settings/shared bind contexts.

name: Rig Master生成Proxy Rig

effects.scene_read: Resolve configured absolute rig cache roots through the shared asset_info_collector; inventory cache outputs and only lightly audit outside-cache dependency candidates/protected helpers.
effects.scene_write: Prepare can explicitly remove local FitSkeleton construction subtrees and unused meshes, simplify authorized zero-contribution nodes, and batch-edit texture directories or visibility drivers. Apply performs plan-driven reduction, native skin and expression restoration, source retention and verified replacement. Finalize removes disposable originals and optionally applies controller tags/GPU settings before save. Apply does not delete joints/controllers. Generated outputs disable inherited smooth preview; sources retain display settings.
effects.file_read: Reads an optional managed JSON plan and records supplied Master provenance.
effects.file_write: Every mode writes the full inventory artifact. Apply saves an independently versioned Proxy scene via save_scene and writes its build report.
effects.host_state_write: Apply changes the sandbox scene filename after successful construction; selection is restored inside the construction transaction. No host restart, scene open or camera/display setup.

preparation.description: prepare mode: fit_skeleton=true deletes existing local FitSkeleton subtrees regardless of hierarchy or namespace. Explicit UUID arrays constant_subtrees preserve undriven scalar destinations; discard_meshes require no effective consumers. zero_weight_nodes handles undriven exact-zero *_W_* authoring coefficients into blendWeighted only; visibility_values contains explicit editable numeric driver plugs. textures_1k checks each texMaster_1k directory once and bulk replaces texMaster path components without checking individual filenames. One native undo transaction; no save. Never prune currently-zero animated BS weights.

mode.description: Prepare performs explicit Proxy-only scene cleanup in one reversible transaction without saving; inspect indexes source outputs; preview validates a plan; apply builds a candidate. Finalize checks the exact build manifest, removes disposable originals, preserves live binding inputs and saves a new Proxy version. finalize_preview only reads.

build_path.description: Managed original build JSON required for finalize/finalize_preview. The current scene must match its output_path; exact original UUIDs and container children are checked, never wildcard-deleted.

controller_options.description: Optional exact maya.rig.controller_tags parameters for finalize. Shared implementation runs after cleanup verification as the last scene operation before save; host settings are restored on failure. Agent inspects identities first. No executable callbacks in output.

character.description: Canonical character name, preserving source capitalization, used for stable output mesh naming.

plan.description: AI decisions: policy_version, scene_path/fingerprint, character, optional cache UUID scope, reduce_entries, merge_groups, region_entries [{source_uuid,reason,regions:[{name,faces,keep_face_ratio,preserve_border,output_name}],quality:{max_error,max_retries,retry_factor,on_exceeded,samples_per_shell}}], keep/protect, optional discard [{uuid,reason,evidence}], cleanup_unused_materials, retain_sources, source_master and weight options. Shared regional outputs combine compatible static source groups before one final skin. Optional sampled per-source-shell shape feedback precedes binding and rebuilds failed groups only; thresholds are caller decisions, not universal acceptance. Multi-source BS/component-set assembly is refused. Face partitions are exhaustive and nonoverlapping. Sources are pruned before reduction and combine; originals remain hidden for revision. Schema/validation live in proxy_rig.plan; no executable code.

plan_path.description: Alternative managed projects/runs JSON plan path; cannot be combined with plan.

output_path.description: Preview/apply require an explicit managed filename containing character and _proxyRig_vNNN. Proxy version is independently selected; save_scene prevents overwrite and increments only that Proxy stem.

preconditions: Finalize requires explicit user authorization to clear candidate originals, an exact candidate build_path and a new output_path. It checks both child shapes and source-history deformers/combinationShape consumers, preserves effective binding inputs under hidden cgi_proxy_binding_inputs, removes empty recorded backup containers, and guards final surfaces plus native deformation input connections. It writes a finalized build artifact without rerunning reduction or pruning weights.

Optional plan.geometry_search maps ordinary final output names to search objects; region_entries[].regions[].search uses the same internal grouping/search on reducible faces. Each requires score_band=[low,high] and radius in current scene units; optional initial_reduction=90, max_evaluations=5 (1..8), samples_per_shell=512 (32..4096), minimal_faces=12. Source construction data is cached once per operation. UV borders remain protected for connected or unknown materials; known constant surface shaders relax only that constraint. UV sets/interpolation and source correspondence remain. Groups record actual constraints, attempts and stop reason. Criteria are caller-chosen, not universal deformation guarantees.

Agent resolves the character's formal Master, stages a sandbox and observes category representatives through existing CGI observation tools before supplying a reduction plan. This API does not replace the open-ended visual decision with a numeric threshold.
Current scene and every output/plan artifact must stay under managed projects/runs. Formal source files are provenance only and are never opened or modified by this operation.
The plan's structural identity must match the current scene. Every scoped cache output requires a processing, keep, protect or evidence-backed discard decision; hidden meshes are not assumed unused.

Optimization targets come exclusively from configured stages.rig.geom_roots through the shared Maya cache/output resolver. Absolute candidate ambiguity is refused, not replaced by a global leaf-name search. Cache-external meshes are only dependency-audited and never reduced or merged.

Explicit discard requires an indexed leaf-output UUID, reason and evidence, with fresh checks for outgoing/message consumers, transform attachments, shared/non-skin deformation and script-name dependencies. Incoming local/ancestor display switching alone does not make a dispensable external proxy a rig consumer. All child shapes including Orig are checked before deletion. Redundancy is not inferred from visibility or location.

Optional cleanup_unused_materials calls Autodesk MLdeleteUnused only after geometry passes. Utility/math/imagePlane nodes, assigned shading groups and rig/script-connected rendering nodes plus their native-history rendering networks are protected; temporary node locks are restored. Every edge touching the protected rendering nodes is guarded, including an endpoint previously classified as a cleanup candidate. Protected UUID or critical-connection loss rolls back the entire build. This phase cleans isolated unused materials/textures, not arbitrary utility nodes.

Ordinary reduce/combine sources require one unreferenced non-instanced skin-only output without child transforms or active downstream/name consumers. Explicit regional sources retain their original dependencies and support one native skin plus one local pre-skin blendShape, original-vertex static delta remapping and intact indexed live-head targets. Unsupported deformation spaces or correspondence are refused.

Combine requires matching parent, local/ancestor/shape display switching, whole-object user sets/layers and skin method. The original visibility inputs and common ancestor switching are retained; topology-dependent component sets require protection.

Native viewport isolation objectSets are excluded from business membership/fingerprints by exact getPanel/isolateSelect ownership queries, cached once per inventory. Similar-looking business set names are not excluded.

Maya undo must be enabled. Geometry core and DAIR-inspired mature solver dependencies must pass preflight before any scene write. ng_proportional remains a separately callable weight API, outside this transaction.

name: 清理蒙皮权重

effects.scene_read: Batch-reads explicit skinCluster weights, influences, locks and binding context for preflight and verification.
effects.scene_write: Apply proportionally removes threshold weights, then fits only still-over-cap vertices and their bounded topology neighborhood. Threshold-only neighbors receive bounded edit-delta propagation without fitting. No primary edits means no smoothing. ng_proportional keeps its validated path. Both optionally detach exact zero relations and set requested maxInfluences/maintainMaxInfluences. Native writes use one undoable MPxCommand and bulk OpenMaya arrays, full or changed-component subsets; ordinary influence editing locks are restored. No joints are deleted and no scene is opened or saved.
effects.host_state_write: dair_inspired may register the bundled Python weight-write command and run one hidden external numerical process using solver_runtime.json and the registered Notes brain runtime; Maya only uses its own NumPy and scene I/O, never imports external SciPy. Numeric request/result artifacts remain in a unique managed-workspace subfolder. ng_proportional requires already loaded ngSkinTools2. Selection is restored; no dependency installation, Maya restart or scene reopen.

method.description: Tiered independent adaptation first performs proportional threshold cleanup; only remaining over-cap rows and their neighborhood enter synthetic bind-skeleton LBS fitting. Small bounded QPs use a direct active-set linear solve with SciPy SLSQP fallback in the registered external numeric process. Maya NumPy is not replaced. This is not the author's DAIR implementation. ng_proportional preserves the previously verified proportional filtering engine.

solver_workdir.description: Optional absolute directory inside an existing managed CGI workspace for numeric request/result artifacts. Public CGI calls default to run_dir/work/skin_solver. Direct Maya Python calls infer the owner of the current managed scene, otherwise require this parameter. Failed owned request folders are retained.

skin_clusters.description: Explicit unique skinCluster names. A non-empty scene requires this scope; no implicit selection or whole-scene cleanup.

mode.description: Inspect checks explicit source skins, actual weights and input membership without solver geometry or synthetic-pose preparation. Apply prepares solver inputs only when primary vertices exist, then solves and verifies within one recoverable native undo boundary.

threshold.description: Original effective weights at or below this value are excluded before capping. Every positive output effective weight must also be strictly above it. DAIR-inspired fits within a guarded output floor inside the same coupled objective (tau plus max(1e-10,32 ULP), capped by 1/support_count); neighbors keep their original feasible positive support and box constraints. Finite [0,1); all-empty rows are refused. ng_proportional preserves retained ratios and filters its documented sub-1e-9 numeric noise.

max_influences.description: Positive maximum number of nonzero influences per vertex, not total attached influences on the skinCluster.

neighbor_rings.description: Topology rings around actual edits; 0 disables neighbors. Threshold-only rows use proportional cleanup and bounded edit-delta propagation. Only rows still above K enter local deformation fitting; second-ring adjustment is tapered. Disconnected shells are never crossed.

neighbor_max_delta.description: DAIR-inspired only. Finite absolute effective-weight adjustment bound in (0,1] for each neighboring weight. Neighbors retain their original positive support and sum-one simplex; no new influence is added. Default 0.02 is an independent adaptation policy, not an original DAIR author parameter.

remove_unused_influences.description: Detach actual all-zero skin influence relations after filtering. Does not delete joint nodes.

preconditions: 项目配置通过统一 config/{project}_config.json 接口加载。
后台模式由 CGI Worker 打开或复用对应 DCC 场景。

dair_inspired requires native Maya NumPy and the explicitly registered external numerical runtime in solver_runtime.json; a real constrained-solve dependency probe is cached by runtime/source fingerprint. Maya never imports the worker's SciPy. Native LBS skinningMethod=0, relativeSpaceMode=0, full polygon membership and no existing ng layer data are required. Neutral Rig Master DAG offsets anchor synthetic ancestor pivots; finite generated poses do not guarantee unseen animation quality.
ng_proportional requires ngSkinTools2 2.4.0 already loaded, no active painting, no existing target layer data, and unlocked weighted influences when filtering changes rows.

Explicit unique polygon skinCluster scope; finite nonempty rows (DAIR clips negative tails only when total negative mass per vertex is at most 1e-7, then proportionally normalizes positive weights; larger negative mass is rejected), supported normalization and at most 32000000 stored weight values per batch. Unwritable/driven weights are refused. DAIR's compressed active coefficient buffer is bounded to 16000000 values.

outputs.engine: Actual method identity, host NumPy and external numeric-worker dependency versions, runtime owner/fingerprint and algorithm_version for DAIR-inspired; engine_version for ngSkinTools2.
outputs.mode: Inspect or apply, with effective threshold and max_influences.
outputs.skins: Per-target counts, changed vertices, before/after influence cap, detached influence UUIDs and write verification. Tiered metrics separate threshold rows, over-cap rows and solver vertices; numeric_solver_skipped identifies proportional-only processing. Cap-fitting energy compares against its local proportional baseline after threshold cleanup, not the entire original character. Metrics are not animation speed or unseen-motion bounds.
outputs.timing_seconds: DAIR capture-and-solve, apply-and-verify and total durations, plus non-overlapping detail phases. Detail phases are subsets of their parent durations and must not be added again.
outputs.warnings: Method-specific numeric margins, strict source/output threshold semantics and independent-adaptation/synthetic-pose limits. Numerical guards do not permit a positive output weight at or below the business threshold.
outputs.summary: Optional framework operation summary; present when the adapter supplies one.
outputs.items: Optional framework item records; present when the adapter supplies them.

有效来源角点法线为权威；不保证同时保留目标旧边平滑标志。仅缺失来源法线且 FC/FI、顶点数严格相同时复制目标原生 mesh data，更新点和来源 UV，保留锁定法线与平滑信息；不同拓扑按新几何生成法线。
缺失法线的同拓扑复制要求目标至少一套 UV set；无 UV set 在全局预检与直接注入中明确拒绝。复制数据与目标持久 UV 清写期间保持旧 set 名，均写入同一旧 first/default set；每次清除后重新取得 MFnMesh，来源缺 UV 时也清除旧数据。全部持久化后保留该默认 set、删除其他 set，再将真实目标正规化成单套 map1，不重命名内存数据块。
所有完整注入分支均在 cachedInMesh 写入后清除目标持久 UV，每次清除后重新取得 MFnMesh，再写入完整来源 UV 与逐面分配；来源合法缺 UV 时也清除旧持久数据。显式来源法线和非同拓扑生成法线分支同样执行，不仅限于复制目标 mesh data 的分支。
待注入 Orig 的 pnts 不得有输入驱动；完整 base 写入后仅清零并读回核验本次注入 Orig 的旧 pnts，不扫描可见 shape 或未替换 RIG。静态可见 shape 仅零 pnts 且无驱动时可直接写入。

effects.scene_read: native mode queries Maya hitTest in an explicit current modelEditor and reads only view/session and returned node identities; no scene-wide geometry or vertex scan. verified mode revalidates complete bounded visible polygon geometry before and after intersections.
effects.file_read: verified mode reads managed original PNG and immutable observation sidecar and verifies SHA-256; native mode does not claim historical-image freshness.

mode.description: native is a current-viewport candidate query using Maya hitTest; use for daily identification. verified preserves the existing full polygon/hash validation of a saved grounded PNG.

observation.description: Required in verified mode: exact {path,sha256} reference returned by grounded maya_capture_viewport. A native result is not a guarded-edit observation token.

panel.description: Required in native mode: explicit visible modelPanel. The modelEditor control is resolved natively; no activation or focus change.

expected_view.description: Optional native-mode lightweight context from ordinary viewport capture output.observation. Checks scene/frame/API, matching panel camera/display and dimensions; does not certify geometry or historical PNG freshness.

pixels.description: 1..20 integer [x,y] indices, top-left origin. native uses the current full modelPanel port (ordinary viewport PNG is 1:1); verified uses the exact original grounded PNG.

expected_target.description: Optional exact full DAG target. verified uses a captured target; native resolves the current node and only reports a definite match for one resolved candidate without unresolved native hits.

preconditions: Maya GUI main thread and explicit visible native full-port modelPanel.

native: current visible modelPanel and in-range integer pixels. Native result order/frontmost/opacity/semantic labels are not certified; preserve all candidates and unresolved hits, never select the first arbitrarily. At most 200 candidate identities in one request; excess rejects.

native: optional expected_view must match cheap current view context; view/session/selection state must remain unchanged during the batch. Maya native filtering and isolate display are honored rather than replaced by a geometry scan.
verified: grounded original PNG/sidecar hashes and complete supported polygon/view state remain unchanged. Normal/reference full shaded drawing is recorded; no UI editability certification.

verified: filter/isolate/template/bbox/unshaded/hidden or alpha overrides/non-default layers/custom rendering/smooth preview reject; all visible polygon candidates remain in occlusion checks and unsupported nearest appearance returns unknown.

outputs.items: native: raw_hits, resolved candidate identities and unresolved_hits without a depth-order guarantee. verified: nearest camera-clipped geometry; ties return AMBIGUOUS_POLYGON_GEOMETRY and unsupported appearance returns UNSUPPORTED_PIXEL_APPEARANCE with null match.
outputs.count: Number of requested pixels processed.
outputs.truncated: Always false; unsupported or over-budget candidate sets reject rather than truncate occluders.
outputs.observation: native returns cheap current view metadata, not a strict edit-guard token; verified returns the validated original observation reference.
outputs.scope: Explicit current-native or verified-geometry semantics, freshness and rendering limits.

help.scenario: Known target: query it directly and frame or isolate when authorized. Unknown region: ordinary viewport capture, inspect PNG, native pick, inspect candidates. Use verified only when saved-image consistency or its strict edit guard is required.
help.safety: Native candidates are current Maya control hits without historical PNG, depth-order or rendered-pixel certification. Verified geometry also does not certify arbitrary shader/texture/light or final-render ownership.

effects.file_write: Updates exact runtime ownership and operation outcome metadata; explicit dead-owner discard preserves a LOST workspace binding when host publication is complete.
effects.host_state_write: Default release reads fresh dirty/path state through registered host execution and shuts down owned warm hosts. Explicit discard directly stops the exact-owned tree and abandons unsaved scenes, including a worker blocked by an earlier read-only control query.

project.description: Exact project key owning the workspace.

runtime_id.description: Exact runtime identity returned by status or execution.

generation.description: Exact runtime generation returned by status or execution.

discard.description: Explicitly discard owned unsaved/unknown host state; does not cancel live active or pending work.

preconditions: Live active or pending work refuses release even with discard. Default release requires fresh confirmed clean hosts.

Blender background native dirty flags do not establish scene cleanliness. Fresh headless observations report dirty and clean_state UNKNOWN, preserve native_dirty, and refuse default release even after a successful save action.
Explicit discard skips another queued host query after draining, so a previous timed-out read-only control query cannot block authorized exact-owned process cleanup.
Unknown RPC or process stop outcome remains DRAINING. Incomplete host launch publication retains the slot even after exact worker death.
Dead-owner recovery requires explicit discard and confirmed identity; abandoned operations become NEEDS_ATTENTION and lost workspace binding requires explicit open, with no write replay.

outputs.released: Whether the owned physical resource was confirmed stopped and removed from active slots.
outputs.recovered: Whether confirmed dead-owner recovery retained a LOST workspace binding.
outputs.binding_state: LOST after dead-owner recovery; a later continue refuses until explicit open.
outputs.hosts: Fresh host dirty/path observations when the live worker responded. Background Blender reports dirty UNKNOWN, clean_state UNKNOWN, dirty_basis native_notifier_unconsumed and the unmodified native_dirty bool; a successful file save never authorizes release or discard.
outputs.discarded: Whether a live runtime was explicitly discarded without another host-query RPC.

errors.RUNTIME_HOST_DIRTY: Dirty or UNKNOWN host state refuses default release.
errors.RUNTIME_CONTROL_UNKNOWN: RPC, identity or stop outcome remains unknown; slot remains occupied.
errors.RUNTIME_PUBLICATION_UNKNOWN: Host launch intents or identities are incomplete; slot remains occupied.
errors.RUNTIME_CONTROL_FAILED: Runtime control could not establish its required preconditions.

Default rejects minimized windows; explicit minimized_policy=restore temporarily displays the target without activation and restores its placement/minimized state. The temporary window may become visible and Windows may show a capture border. Desktop scope never changes windows.

manifest_relpath.description: Required for preview/apply; sealed source and optional target member manifest relative to maintenance. Optional foreground_confirmation: schema_version=1, kind=cgi_workspace_foreground_scope_confirmation, exact maintenance_root, finite recorded_at/expires_at Unix times (nonfuture, at most 4 hours), nonempty original statement/evidence, processes=[{pid,create_time,exe}], scopes=[{source_root,target_root}]. Identities, exact managed roots and fixed expiry are rechecked before rename; human evidence never overrides readable scenes/references or CGI ownership. Reconcile rereads the original operation manifest.

manifest_sha256.description: Required approved manifest SHA256 for preview/apply. Reconcile cannot change the original approved scope.

activity_relpath.description: Fresh complete original-storage activity attestation relative to maintenance workspace.

target_activity_relpath.description: Fresh complete destination activity for preserve_members.

sealed exact source and target scope
no active or unresolved operation and no resident owning runtime.

outputs.preview: Present and true for preview; no migration commit.
outputs.foreground_evidence: Preflight evidence distinguishes machine_inspected scene paths from operator_recorded_confirmation; successful apply also rechecks the same sealed scope before rename and records that result in the native journal.
outputs.binding: Verified new native binding; its project is the storage namespace.
outputs.old_binding: Original native identity preserved for Notes compare-and-swap maintenance.
outputs.relocation_task_id: Original server operation identity; never resubmit an unknown outcome.
outputs.receipt_manifest_relpath: Flat maintenance proof manifest used by read-only binding verification.
outputs.receipt_manifest_sha256: SHA256 of both sealed proof manifest and target commit witness.
outputs.rolled_back: True after explicit original-ID reconciliation safely restores both precommit roots.
outputs.original_task_id: Original interrupted relocation ID; reconciliation never replays it.

errors.WORKSPACE_RELOCATION_CONFLICT: Existing target members or another relocation conflict with this operation.
errors.WORKSPACE_RELOCATION_FOREGROUND_UNKNOWN: Complete scene inspection or a valid exact ordinary-process human confirmation is unavailable; no generic foreground bypass is supported.
errors.WORKSPACE_RELOCATION_FOREGROUND_OWNED: A machine-read scene or Maya reference belongs to the relocation roots; human statements cannot override it.

recovery: Use get_task_result with the original control operation ID; a prepared operation without a commit returns attention and must not be replayed.
